principle: A free diagnostic should turn one completed result into another qualified user before asking for PII.

implementation.privacy: Challenge URL contains only score, risk category and campaign attribution; no name, email or company data.
implementation.conversion: The portal/order CTA remains visible after the comparison.

root_cause: The free diagnostic previously ended as an individual result and did not create a privacy-safe mechanism for a second qualified user or an immediate action loop.
prevention: Keep the team-challenge and Bedrijfsgeheugen Mini contracts regression-tested so every completed diagnostic can create action and a second qualified user before paid conversion, without requiring PII.
